instructions: This fork's work is in client-v2/; hold it to client-v2/CLAUDE.md. server/ and wasm/ are upstream's code and arrive through chore(upstream) sync PRs: review them for merge correctness only, do not propose refactors there. client/ is upstream's too, stays byte-identical to it, and is left out of review by ignorePatterns. Under wasm/ the fork owns one script and the wasm-bindgen pins, and the rest of each manifest is upstream's: wasm/stub-packages.sh; the exact wasm-bindgen version under [workspace.dependencies] in wasm/Cargo.toml, with the member manifests that refer to it as wasm-bindgen = { workspace = true }; and the exact wasm-bindgen version in wasm/rust-analyzer/Cargo.toml. Flag any PR, sync PRs included, that removes the script, replaces a member's workspace = true with a version of its own, or changes a pin without that manifest's own Cargo.lock; the wasm/ pins note in CLAUDE.md gives the reason. Specs are the contract: for a client-v2 change, read openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md for each capability the PR touches, and openspec/changes/<name>/ (proposal.md, specs/, tasks.md) when the PR names an active change. Archived changes live under openspec/changes/archive/<date>-<name>/; when a PR edits code that an archived change introduced, read that change's proposal.md and design.md for the reasoning before calling the code wrong. A finished change is archived, without tasks.md, in the PR that ticks its last task, unless that PR states OpenSpec: <change> stays open; an archived change is a record and is not edited afterwards. Flag a PR that ticks a change's last task with neither, a PR that leaves a tasks.md in an archived change, and a PR that edits a folder under openspec/changes/archive/ that it did not archive. Every #### Scenario in a spec is either a Playwright test in client-v2/e2e/ or marked (manual); flag a behaviour change with neither.
